localFacts.fact: KLM hand baggage may not exceed 55 x 35 x 25 cm including wheels and handles: the Befree Live (40 cm folded) and Peak Design (about 39 cm) fit; the AD-01 (89 cm), TP74 (91 cm) and Sachtler (86 cm) go in the hold.
Gemeente Amsterdam: filming in the city requires a filmmelding at least 4 weeks in advance; the melding is free and the full rules are in the city's Filmprotocol.
Rijksmuseum: visitors may film and photograph as long as it does not disturb others; for bridal photography the museum's terms mean no tripods and no extra lighting.
Dutch terms: fluid head / vloeistofkop, kombasis of halve bol van 75 mm, tegengewicht (counterbalance), middenspreider; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Dutch photographers are unsure whether a tripod counts as a blunt weapon in hand baggage.
localPainPoints.fix: A kit that folds to about 40 cm fits KLM's 55 x 35 x 25 cm limit; pack the 86-91 cm video tripods in checked baggage; security staff make the final call.
